## Dative alternation: length of recipient

::: {.r-fit-text style="text-align: center"}
I gave *them* a book.

I gave a book to *my friend's mom*.
:::

## The data

```{r}
#| label: dative
#| echo: true

library(languageR)
data("dative")

dative

```

## Realisation of recipient

```{r}
#| label: dat-realisation

dative |>
  ggplot(aes(RealizationOfRecipient, fill = RealizationOfRecipient)) +
  geom_bar() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

```

## Length of recipient

```{r}
#| label: dat-length

dative |>
  ggplot(aes(LengthOfRecipient)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 1, fill = "cadetblue") +
  labs(x = "Length of recipient (number of words)")

```

## Realisation and length

```{r}
#| label: dat-real-length
#| echo: true
#| output-location: slide

dative <- dative |> 
  mutate(
    Realisation_num = ifelse(RealizationOfRecipient == "NP", 0, 1)
  )

dative |> 
  ggplot(aes(LengthOfRecipient, Realisation_num)) +
  geom_smooth(
    method = "glm",
    method.args = list(family = "binomial"),
    colour = "sienna"
  ) +
  ylim(0, 1)
```

## Regression model

```{r}
#| label: dat-bm
#| echo: true

dat_bm <- brm(
  RealizationOfRecipient ~ LengthOfRecipient,
  family = "bernoulli",
  data = dative,
  seed = 3926,
  file = "cache/dat_bm"
)

summary(dat_bm)
```

## Posterior distributions

```{r}
#| label: dat-bm-dens

mcmc_plot(dat_bm, type = "dens")
```

## Odd ratio of the effect of length

```{r}
#| label: dat-bm-draws
#| echo: true
#| output-location: column

dat_bm_draws <- as_draws_df(dat_bm) |> 
  mutate(
    Length_OR = exp(b_LengthOfRecipient)
  )

dat_bm_draws |> 
  ggplot(aes(Length_OR)) +
  geom_density(fill = "aquamarine4", alpha = 0.5) +
  labs(x = "Odd ratio of the effect of recipient length")
```

. . .

```{r}
#| label: dat-bm-draws-cri

dat_bm_draws |>
  summarise(
    `90%` = paste0("[", paste(quantile2(Length_OR, c(0.05, 0.95)) |> round(2), collapse = ", "), "]"),
    `80%` = paste0("[", paste(quantile2(Length_OR, c(0.1, 0.9)) |> round(2), collapse = ", "), "]"),
    `70%` = paste0("[", paste(quantile2(Length_OR, c(0.15, 0.85)) |> round(2), collapse = ", "), "]"),
    `60%` = paste0("[", paste(quantile2(Length_OR, c(0.2, 0.8)) |> round(2), collapse = ", "), "]"),
    `40%` = paste0("[", paste(quantile2(Length_OR, c(0.3, 0.7)) |> round(2), collapse = ", "), "]")
    ) |>
  knitr::kable(align = c("ccccc"))
```

## From 1 to 2 to 3 words

```{r}
#| label: dat-bm-1-5
#| echo: true

dat_bm_draws <- dat_bm_draws |> 
  mutate(
    p_1 = plogis(b_Intercept + b_LengthOfRecipient),
    p_2 = plogis(b_Intercept + b_LengthOfRecipient * 2),
    p_3 = plogis(b_Intercept + b_LengthOfRecipient * 3),
    p_2_1 = p_2 - p_1, p_3_2 = p_3 - p_2,
  )

quantile2(dat_bm_draws$p_2_1, probs = c(0.05, 0.95)) |> round(2)
quantile2(dat_bm_draws$p_3_2, probs = c(0.05, 0.95)) |> round(2)
```

## Expected values

```{r}
#| label: dat-bm-epred
#| echo: true
#| output-location: slide

library(tidybayes)

pred_grid <- tibble(
  LengthOfRecipient = seq(
    min(dative$LengthOfRecipient),
    max(dative$LengthOfRecipient)
  )
)

dat_bm_epred <- epred_draws(dat_bm, pred_grid) |> 
  mutate(
    median = median(.epred),
    lower = quantile2(.epred, probs = 0.025),
    upper = quantile2(.epred, probs = 0.975)
  )

dat_bm_epred |> 
  ggplot(aes(LengthOfRecipient, median)) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = lower, ymax = upper), alpha = 0.2) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1, colour = "sienna")
```

## Results

::: {.callout-note appearance="simple"}
- At 90% confidence, the probability of the recipient being realised as PP increases by a factor of 1.9 to 2.15 for each extra word in the recipient.

- The probability of a PP increases by 11-13 percentage points from 1 to 2 words, at 90% probability.
  (But it is still below 50%, so an NP is still more likely).

- Above 10 words, an PP is virtually certain.
:::
